title: The TV clock is blurred to hide the re-cut
text: The TV clock is blurred to hide that it is a re-cut: a clock that jumps between pieces shows the edit. The clock and the 3HD bug are fine on studio frames; cover them where they would show the cut.

source.heading: Confirmed by the user (2026-11-24, answers to the overnight study's questions)

confirm: Where would a jumping clock show a cut, and is it covered there?
